nodes.label: Calcium Chloride (CaCl2) Hygroscopic Salt Sorbent
nodes.source_file: give all your numbers' resources and add links to....txt
nodes.rationale: High-performance low-cost hygroscopic salt; deliquescence/leakage is mitigated by hosting it in a porous matrix (crushed clay for lowest cost, silica gel for optimum).

nodes.label: Silica Gel Host Matrix for Composite Sorbents

nodes.label: Solar Sorbent Box (Day/Night Solar-Regenerated Desiccant AWH Unit)
nodes.source_file: give all your numbers' resources and add links to....txt
nodes.rationale: Night sorption phase pulls humid air over the sorbent with fans; day desorption phase seals the box so solar heating releases vapor that condenses on an angled aluminum plate, like a solar oven crossed with a water heater.

nodes.label: Lowest Functional AWH System (~2350 EGP)
nodes.source_file: give all your numbers' resources and add links to....txt
nodes.rationale: Bare-bones proof of concept: CaCl2 in crushed clay, salvaged wood frame, thin aluminum condenser, window glass, passive convection; trades yield and lifespan for minimum entry cost.

nodes.label: Optimum Value AWH System (~5700 EGP)
nodes.source_file: give all your numbers' resources and add links to....txt
nodes.rationale: CaCl2 in silica gel, insulated sealed frame, heat-sinked condenser, polycarbonate glazing, fan-forced airflow; targets ~1.0 L/kg/day and long lifespan for best long-term value.
